# A list reaches nothing but its own `_on_changed`: bool, dropdown, numeric,
# slider and button settings auto-apply and reach `cmf_on_callback`, and a list
# reaches neither until `cmm_apply_list_change` is called here.

	}
}

# «{'plus': '+1', 'minus': '−1'}[what]» на месте 1 блока грамот. **Ячейка
# написана под место, а не под грамоту**: какая грамота на нём сидит, говорит
# `_rslot1`, и диспетчер ниже попадает в её собственный эффект. Без этого
# невидимая ячейка держала бы своё место в ряду, а девять грамот из тринадцати
# вставали бы рваными столбцами -- 2026-09-06.
bag_wtp_right_plus_slot_1 = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_4 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 5 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_5 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 6 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_6 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 7 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_7 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 8 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_8 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 9 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_9 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 10 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_10 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 11 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_11 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 12 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_12 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 13 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_13 = yes }
		bag_wtp_recompute_live = yes
	}
}

bag_wtp_right_minus_slot_1 = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_4 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 5 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_5 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 6 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_6 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 7 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_7 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 8 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_8 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot1 = 9 } bag_wtp_edit_right_minus_9 = yes }

# `_rslot3`, и диспетчер ниже попадает в её собственный эффект. Без этого
# невидимая ячейка держала бы своё место в ряду, а девять грамот из тринадцати
# вставали бы рваными столбцами -- 2026-09-06.
bag_wtp_right_plus_slot_3 = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_4 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 5 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_5 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 6 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_6 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 7 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_7 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 8 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_8 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 9 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_9 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 10 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_10 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 11 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_11 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 12 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_12 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot3 = 13 } bag_wtp_edit_right_plus_13 = yes }
		bag_wtp_recompute_live = yes
	}
}

		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot13 = 12 } bag_wtp_swap_right_set_12 = yes }
		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rslot13 = 13 } bag_wtp_swap_right_set_13 = yes }
		bag_wtp_recompute_live = yes
	}
}
